void show_wave(PA45_Global_t *this)
{
    static uint8_t wave_inited = 0;
    static uint32_t last_sample_tick = 0;
    static Page_e last_page = PAGE_LOGO;

    if (!wave_inited)
    {
        wave_display_init();
        wave_inited = 1;
    }

    if (this->page == PAGE_CURVE && last_page != PAGE_CURVE)
    {
        wave_force_refresh();
    }

    last_page = this->page;

#if FPS_DISP_ENABLE
    /* FPS / CPU load auto-refresh (self-throttled, no external call needed) */
    wave_stats_update();
#endif

    if (this->page != PAGE_CURVE)
    {
        return;
    }

    
    if (wave_dialog_is_open())
    {
        return;
    }

    
    if (this->wave_record_state == STATE_WAVE_RECORD_START && !g_recording_active)
    {
        if (g_replay_mode_active)
        {
            this->wave_replay_state = STATE_WAVE_REPLAY_STOP;
            g_replay_mode_active = 0;
            wave_clear();
            draw_voltage_scale();
            draw_current_scale();
        }
        g_recording_active = 1;
        g_record_point_cnt = 0;
        g_replay_loaded = 0; /* recording overrides any loaded slot */
        g_record_start_tick = xTaskGetTickCount();
        g_last_record_sample_tick = g_record_start_tick;
        g_blink_show = 0;
        g_last_blink_tick = 0;
    }
    
    else if (this->wave_record_state == STATE_WAVE_RECORD_FINISH && g_recording_active)
    {
        g_recording_active = 0;
        memcpy(g_replay_voltage, g_record_voltage, sizeof(int16_t) * g_record_point_cnt);
        memcpy(g_replay_current, g_record_current, sizeof(int16_t) * g_record_point_cnt);
        g_replay_point_cnt = g_record_point_cnt;
        
        if (g_replay_point_cnt > 0)
            wave_dialog_open_save(this);
    }

    
    if (this->wave_replay_state == STATE_WAVE_REPLAY_STOP)
    {
        g_replay_loaded = 0;
        if (g_replay_mode_active)
        {
            g_replay_mode_active = 0;
            wave_clear();
            draw_voltage_scale();
            draw_current_scale();
        }
    }
    
    else if (this->wave_replay_state == STATE_WAVE_REPLAY_PLAY)
    {
        if (!g_replay_mode_active && g_replay_point_cnt > 0)
        {
            g_replay_mode_active = 1;
            g_replay_loaded = 0;
            g_replay_pos = 0;
            g_replay_last_tick = 0;
            g_replay_display_voltage = (float)g_replay_voltage[0] / RECORD_VOLT_SCALE;
            g_replay_display_current = ((float)g_replay_current[0] / RECORD_CURR_SCALE) / 1000.0f;
            wave_clear();
        }
    }

    
    draw_recording_indicator();

    
    wave_scrub_process(this);

    if (g_replay_mode_active)
    {
        if (this->wave_replay_state == STATE_WAVE_REPLAY_PLAY)
        {
            if (g_replay_pos < g_replay_point_cnt)
            {
                uint32_t now = xTaskGetTickCount();
                if ((now - g_replay_last_tick) >= pdMS_TO_TICKS(SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS))
                {
                    g_replay_last_tick = now;
                    /* convert fixed-point back to volts / mA */
                    float v = (float)g_replay_voltage[g_replay_pos] / RECORD_VOLT_SCALE;
                    float c = (float)g_replay_current[g_replay_pos] / RECORD_CURR_SCALE;
                    g_replay_pos++;
                    wave_add_point(v, c);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                this->wave_replay_state = STATE_WAVE_REPLAY_STOP;
                g_replay_mode_active = 0;
                wave_clear();
                draw_voltage_scale();
                draw_current_scale();
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        
        if (this->wave_play_state == STATE_WAVE_PAUSE)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (g_replay_loaded)
        {
            return;
        }

        uint32_t now = xTaskGetTickCount();
        if ((now - last_sample_tick) >= pdMS_TO_TICKS(LIVE_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS))
        {
            last_sample_tick = now;
            wave_add_point(spa45.input_ina226_voltage, spa45.input_ina226_cur
